mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing Augustine and Luther through the same meal was most worthwhile: it clarified what each account was trying to explain without treating them as identical.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial supper combination was clear but fairly predictable; the later comparisons did more to develop the idea.

surprise.text: Fasting retained a purpose as self-discipline even though it did not feed the household; the contrast was more nuanced than simply dismissing fasting.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each addressed a stated question or a clear comparison, though the final combination was the only available action.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in another chapter that tests distinctions through concrete cases, especially if it offers further comparisons between writers.
